purpose: Define the first deterministic Python FP32 byte-CNN POC before ONNX export, quantization, Rust inference, or release-holdout evaluation.

training.selection: No early stopping, hyperparameter tuning, or architecture choice uses calibration, historical_test, or release_holdout.

release_holdout: release_holdout is excluded from this POC. It may be evaluated once only after the complete CNN/retrieval/fusion/policy release candidate is frozen.

onnx_parity.status: next sub-phase after this FP32 POC passes
onnx_parity.pytorch_to_onnx_class_decisions: identical on the frozen golden set
onnx_parity.python_onnx_to_rust_ort_class_decisions: identical on the frozen golden set

retention: in-memory POC model and aggregate report only; no model artifact, ONNX graph, per-record predictions, candidate text, or policy decision is written at this stage.
